name: Campingplatz Rueppenhof
beschreibung:
Nestled in the idyllic Thiersee valley, Campingplatz Rueppenhof combines authentic Tyrolean farmstead charm with modern camping comforts. Guests appreciate well-maintained pitches on a sunny slope with scenic mountain vistas.

Nearby Lake Thiersee is perfect for summer swimming and boating, while wonderful hiking paths toward the Kaiser mountains and Pendling summit start right at the door.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Rueppenhof in Thiersee charms with a welcoming family atmosphere and serene Kufsteinerland scenery.
